title: Waves
definition: A wave is a disturbance or oscillation that travels through space and matter, transferring energy from one place to another without transporting the medium itself.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims (General Science - Physics) via direct property-based questions, electromagnetic spectrum, seismic waves, and communication technologies. Mains GS-3 applications include telecommunications, remote sensing, and disaster management (tsunamis/earthquakes).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Mechanical, Electromagnetic, and Matter waves.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and technological applications.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
